Surround your Tier 1 gear with blaze powder. What could go wrong?
Your head is now a portable furnace. You're welcome.
More blaze powder, more heat, fewer regrets about leaving your legs exposed.
For when ordinary boots are no longer enough and the snow wants your toes.
